notes:
Photato 0.3.0 (331) is an unfinished alpha of an independent native Swift image editor. Many planned features are not yet available, and complete PhotoCraft/Photoshop compatibility is not claimed. We understand App Review Guideline 2.2 directs beta software to TestFlight; this package is for validation and draft preparation, not an automatic public App Store submission.

The app is free, with no IAP, tips, subscriptions, login or paid unlocks. Ordinary editing runs locally. Optional Apple Intelligence uses system availability checks on eligible Apple Silicon/macOS26+ systems; image services may use Apple's Private Cloud Compute. An optional authenticated loopback API is disabled until enabled by the user; it shares the native editing engine. File access is user-selected and uses app-scoped bookmarks. The app is sandboxed in its AppStore configuration.

The build demonstrates AI-aided development, with a factual development diary and source attribution. The repository remains private until the software release date. All releases require the maintainer's manual approval. Do not enable automatic release, pre-orders or automatic TestFlight group distribution.
